title: 2 Headed Dragon
author: Troy J.
desc:
2 Headed Dragon is a partner-based Push/Pull/Legs hypertrophy program built for couples who take training seriously. Each workout has a specific emphasis—shoulders, pecs, back width, back thickness, anterior legs, or posterior legs—so every major area gets focused attention.

The program is designed around alternating sets: while one partner lifts, the other rests. Exercises are deliberately ordered to minimize loading, unloading, and equipment changes, keeping the workout moving and maximizing productive training time. Train together, push each other, and get more work done with less wasted time.
